entities.name: Query Ham1p-like pyrophosphatase
observations: 335 aa protein; Pfam Ham1p_like (PF01725.22) spans residues 136–324.
Best reviewed homologs are Streptococcus pyogenes dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases with 61.5–61.8% identity and 98.5% query coverage.
Functional assignment is moderate homology support rather than direct experimental characterization of this query sequence.

entities.name: dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: EC 3.6.1.66; hydrolyzes noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphates to monophosphates and diphosphate.
Reviewed homolog annotations specify high preference for XTP, dITP, and ITP.
Binds one Mg2+ ion per subunit.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis
observations: XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28610.

entities.name: dITP hydrolysis
observations: dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28342.

entities.name: ITP hydrolysis
observations: ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:29399.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Mg2+ is annotated as the cofactor; one Mg2+ ion binds per enzyme subunit.
